headline: Paraguay Joins US 'Pax Silica' AI Supply Chain Pact
summary: Paraguay signed the US-led Pax Silica declaration, pledging its renewable hydropower resources and critical minerals to bolster the American artificial intelligence supply chain.
why: Data centers and AI infrastructure require vast amounts of baseload clean energy, prompting global alliances to secure international power and mineral capacity.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Pact draws foreign capital investment into domestic hydropower and mineral extraction infrastructure.
